Awful Service and mediocre food
Mar 2026 • Couples
We visited the Doki Doki restaurant in the Melia resort in Phu Quoc. 
We had made our reservation on line but when we arrived they didn’t have our booking. 
Fortunately they could accommodate us but the young man on the desk was rude and very abrupt with us, 
The young female waitress was lovely but spoke very little English so I had to google the dishes to see what they were as the menu did not explain. 
We ordered a seafood Pho which I enjoyed but my husband found it very bland. 
We then had sushi which again I thought was ok, nothing special to taste but the presentation was nice. 
My husband wasn’t impressed because we thought we had ordered something different but because of the language barrier we just ate it as it was so difficult trying to explain! 
The food was served very quickly and the dish was brought out before we had finished our first course! 
I ordered a sweet and it wasn’t what I was expecting, it was fruit and ice cream not the dish I had ordered! 
We ordered drinks and they took forever to arrive and once we’d finished our food they didn’t clear our plates for ages. The restaurant had only 14 diners and there were 3 waiting staff so they were hardly short staffed. 
Overall we didn’t enjoy our experience there and felt it was overpriced and service very poor.

Perfect dinner
Dec 2025 • Friends
The Japanese food was just fantastic and a real experience for all the senses. As soon as the dishes were served, it became clear how much love, precision and respect for the ingredients go into Japanese cuisine. Each plate was artfully arranged, almost too beautiful to eat – and in terms of taste, everything even exceeded high expectations.

The aromas were finely tuned, clear and yet intense. Nothing was overseasoned, everything had its balance. You could taste every single ingredient: the fresh fish, the perfectly prepared rice, the harmonious sauces and the fresh herbs. What was particularly impressive was how light and filling the dishes were at the same time – you feel pleasantly satisfied after eating, not heavy.

The quality of the food was excellent. The fish was wonderfully fresh, tender and cooked to the point or served raw, just as it should be. The soups were aromatic, warming and deep in flavour, with a broth that was cooked for a long time and prepared with great care. The supplements, too, were anything but incidental: Every little thing had its place and contributed to the overall experience.

What made this food special was the harmony of tradition and elegance. Japanese cuisine shows that good food does not have to be loud to inspire. It’s all about calmness, quality, aesthetics and respect for the product – and that’s exactly what was felt here. Every bite was a treat and showed how much skill and passion goes into it.

Overall, the Japanese food was not only delicious, but inspiring. It was a culinary moment that you remember and would love to repeat at any time. A real highlight and highly recommended – fantastic from start to finish.

Perfect dinner
Dec 2025 • Friends
🍣🍜 Japanese restaurant – a treat for all the senses 🍱✨

Our visit to this Japanese restaurant was a real highlight and an unforgettable dining experience. As soon as you arrive, you feel welcome – the quiet, stylish ambience creates a relaxed atmosphere in which you can immediately leave everyday life behind. Everything looks harmonious, modern and at the same time traditional Japanese.

The food was just fantastic. Every dish was prepared with great care and beautifully arranged – almost too bad to eat. The freshness of the ingredients was clearly noticeable with each bite. Whether sushi, hot dishes or ramen: Everything was perfectly matched, taste balanced and full of fine aromas. The quality of the fish was particularly impressive – tender, juicy and cooked to the point or served raw.

The ramen were intense in taste, soothing and just right seasoned. The broth was deeply aromatic and the inlays harmonised perfectly. The rice dishes were also excellent: loose, aromatic and ideally combined with fish, vegetables and fine sauces. You immediately notice that the cooking here is passionate and every detail counts.

Another highlight was the presentation of the food. Colours, textures and decorations were lovingly coordinated – each dish a small work of art. The eye definitely eats along here.

The service was attentive, friendly and professional without being intrusive. You felt completely well looked after and could enjoy the evening to the fullest.

Overall, it was an all-round perfect restaurant visit. This Japanese restaurant impresses with excellent food, high quality, stylish ambience and outstanding service. Highly recommended – we will definitely come back! 🍶🌸
